title: Stereotype News
author: Rafael Krux
description: Back when news was exciting, and people wanted to hear it, we had these themes. With... Deborah Channel... Aziz Hummal on weather... Special correspondant... Freddie Holston... and hosts... Gina Klybourne and Gina Smith! Don't let the spinning globe hit you on the way out!
